summary: Full backend + frontend E2E verification of DropBoxer. 13/13 pytest backend tests passed and complete UI flow (home -> upload -> SafeDrop verify -> create share -> result card -> My Shares dashboard -> /share page -> secure download -> burn used state -> invalid share error) verified via Playwright. Burn-after-download atomicity confirmed at both /api/download and /api/file streaming endpoints; second download returns 410 error=used. TimeVault expiry validated by mutating expiryTime in Mongo -> /api/download returns 410 error=expired. SafeDrop rejects .exe / traversal / empty uploads with 422 + safetyStatus=rejected. Share metadata never leaks objectKey.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 260/289: After a burn share is consumed, status is flipped to USED with a SECOND update_one following the atomic find_one_and_update. This is not fully atomic — if the process dies between the two ops, downloadCount==maxDownloads but status stays ACTIVE. The subsequent-request guard '$expr: downloadCount < maxDownloads' still prevents a second successful burn, so correctness holds, but consider setting status:'USED' inside the same $set/$inc using an aggregation pipeline update for perfect atomicity.

/api/file/{share_id}: increments downloadCount BEFORE aws_service.get_object() succeeds. If object storage fails after burn is recorded, the user gets no bytes and the share is permanently USED. Consider fetching bytes first then incrementing, or implementing compensating rollback on storage error.
CORS is wide-open ('*') with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests to '*' and this combination is generally discouraged. Set explicit origins in production.
aws_service.put_object/get_object are sync (requests) but called from async FastAPI endpoints; large uploads will block the event loop. Wrap in run_in_executor or use httpx.AsyncClient.
SHARE_TOKEN_SECRET default 'dbx-dev-secret' fallback in aws_service.token_secret() — safe here because .env sets it, but consider raising if missing in production.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed shares in Mongo 'shares' collection during tests. Not cleaned up (auto-expire via TimeVault or already USED).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_dropboxer.py and cover all 13 spec items. Backend runs behind supervisor at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend UI verified via Playwright at same URL. Note the ~650ms client-side SafeDrop scan delay before upload button is enabled. Burn shares can only be tested with fresh uploads (they self-consume).
